overview: Resonance Basin is the most unstable magical zone in The Grey.
details: Vacuum resonance pulses distort spells, destabilize constructs, and spawn resonance predators. The basin is believed to be the epicenter of ancient Akheva experiments.
hooks: A massive resonance pulse sweeps across the basin.
A silent fissure opens into deeper Akheva ruins.
Magic behaves unpredictably within the basin.
